# Why is your Snowflake bill so high?

> Paste your Snowflake warehouses (size, credits used, AUTO_SUSPEND, resumes) and get what each costs, the AUTO_SUSPEND tail you are paying for, idle warehouses and a bounded right-sizing note, with the ALTER WAREHOUSE commands. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
